item.tib: gsas mkhar rin po che spyi spungs rtsod bzlog gi rgyud las sgra bla'i rgyal mo ma mo 'dus pa'i spyi bskang
item.coloph: snang srid ma mo 'dus pa'i bskang (skong) ba/ bla chen po dran pa nam mkha' yis/ phyi rabs gshen po'i don du mdzad nas/ stang dmu tsha gyer med la gdams pa'o/ de la (yis) las ldan gyi gshen po dbra btsun nam mkha' rin chen gyi snyan du brgyud pa'o/ des khyung po rang grol la phobs so (phab bo)//
